verified_against: K9000 2.0 Twin Specs and Info v1.0 (Tru Blu Dog Wash, 2021)
EMC Compliance Test Report CE3310B (Compliance Engineering, Dec 2021)
_provenance.note: Marketing overclaims removed. Engineering figures below are taken from the manufacturer spec sheet; anything not on a spec sheet is marked unverified or omitted.

do_not_claim: 100% organic / certified organic (products are pet-formulated, NOT certified organic — see organic-claim-truthup)
hypoallergenic (unless a specific product carries that certification)
real-time IoT / sensor monitoring (we receive Nayax payment + device status, NOT pump/water sensor telemetry)
first self-service pet wash in the Middle East (unverified superlative)

k9000_machine.manufacturer: Tru Blu Dog Wash (Australia) — K9000® registered trademark

physical.layout: Twin = one cabinet, two fully independent wash bays (left + right)

electrical.onboard_hot_water_power: 415V 3-phase, 40A (Stiebel Eltron DHB-E 27) — only if onboard hot water unit fitted

water.usage: 16-20 L/min with both bays running (~40-50 L per single dog wash)
water.filtration: Primary stainless-steel mesh + secondary SPS bucket trap (R130SR-BT)
water.backflow: High-hazard backflow prevention required (RPZ or registered air-gap)
water.waste: 2 x 50mm outlets; minor trade-waste application required locally

controller.type: Vending-style machine controller with timed wash cycle + LCD display
controller.native_payment: Coin + note acceptor (per EMC test configuration)
controller.note: The machine is NOT a networked computer with an open API. Remote capability is provided by the bolted-on Nayax payment layer over the MDB bus — see payment.

payment.system: Nayax cashless layer over MDB (Multi-Drop Bus)
devices: Nayax DOT QR Smart Reader (scans the PetWash app QR; supports MDB/JVMA, FUJI, Pulse; 1D/2D/QR/DataMatrix)
payment.per_bay: Each bay has its OWN Nayax card reader and OWN DOT QR reader — the two bays are independent.
payment.control_reality: We start a wash by authorising payment through Nayax, which sends an MDB vend signal; the K9000's local controller then runs the timed cycle. We do not directly drive pumps/dryers.

products.type: Pet-formulated wash, conditioning and treatment products
products.important: Do NOT describe as 'organic', 'certified organic', or 'hypoallergenic' unless a specific product carries that certification.

convenience.accessibility: Step-in tub; check site for wheelchair access (per-site)

safety.temperature_control: Wash temperature factory-set ~35C at the gun
safety.emergency: On-machine controls; the machine's local safety remains authoritative over any remote action

capacity.wash_duration: ~10 minutes standard wash time (recommended price band set per site)

compliance.emc: PASSED EN IEC 61000-6-1:2019 immunity (ESD, radiated/conducted RF, fast-transient burst, surge, voltage dips, magnetic field)
compliance.use: Supports CE/EMC evidence for import and operation. File in the compliance record.

monitoring.what_we_see: Cashless transactions and device online/offline status via the Nayax platform (VPOS Touch + DOT QR over MDB).
monitoring.what_we_do_not_see: Pump pressure, water flow, water-low, or temperature sensors — the K9000 controller does not expose these. Sensor-level telemetry would require adding an external IoT module to the machine (a hardware project).

ai_usage_note: Use these verified specs when customers ask about machine capabilities, safety, payment, or compliance. NEVER reintroduce any claim in do_not_claim. If unsure whether a claim is verified, omit it.
